title: The normalized zero-fibre specialization exchange through the normal cone.
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and $N>0$ with $NA=0$. Let $S,S'$ be Noetherian, with $N$ invertible on $S$. Let $g:V	o S$, $g':V'	o S'$ be smooth separated compactifiable of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$, with closed sections $s,s'$. Use the actual normal cones $C_s,C_{s'}$, their projections $\pi,\pi'$ and zero sections $z,z'$, and extended-Rees families $D_sV,D_{s'}V'$ of [lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation]. Assume these have that lemma's smooth compactifiable Rees geometry, as in the Lean Geometry instances. Write $F=\widetilde s^*\widetilde g^	imes A$ for the section family on $\mathbf A^1_S$ and $C=s^*g^	imes A$; define $F',C'$ similarly. Let $\kappa:F\xrightarrow{\sim}p^*C$ and $\kappa':F'\xrightarrow{\sim}p'^*C'$ be normalized at $1$, meaning their one-fibre restrictions equal the canonical counit-defined one-fibre section comparisons. Suppose $(q,g',g,b)$ is a Cartesian square preserving $s,s'$, and $
u:C_{s'}	o C_s$ is any map with Cartesian square $(
u,\pi',\pi,b)$ and $
u z'=zb$. For the actual counit-defined section comparisons $e_q,e_
u$ and zero specialization maps $\delta_\kappa:C	o z^*\pi^	imes A$ and $\delta_{\kappa'}:C'	o z'^*\pi'^	imes A$ of [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization], one has $e_
u\circ b^*\delta_\kappa=\delta_{\kappa'}\circ e_q$. This is the specialization factor of the integrated square only.

proof.text: Construct the coefficientwise Rees pair map. It is Cartesian by arbitrary-presentation Rees base change. Its compatibility with the augmented section and fibres gives a canonical normal map ν₀. Pullback pasting and cancellation show that the ν₀ square is Cartesian.

Package the Rees family and its fibres at zero and one as an exceptional section family. Pull back invertibility of N to S'. The existing normalized-family uniqueness identifies each supplied κ with the unique normalized trivialization.
Apply normalized exceptional-family base-change coherence and restrict at zero. The explicit comparison identifications give the displayed specialization square for ν₀.

The two Cartesian normal lifts ν and ν₀ preserve the same zero sections. Their section comparisons agree by Cartesian-lift independence; rewrite by this equality to obtain the asserted equation for ν.

lean.statement:
theorem specialization_normalExchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {V S V' S' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian S']
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ S) (g' : V' ⟶ S')
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g']
    [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g] [HasCompactification g]
    [IsSeparated g'] [QuasiCompact g'] [HasCompactification g']
    (s : S ⟶ V) (s' : S' ⟶ V') [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d g s]
    [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d g' s']
    (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S) (hs' : s' ≫ g' = 𝟙 S')
    (b : S' ⟶ S) (q : V' ⟶ V) (cart : IsPullback q g' g b)
    (hsec : s' ≫ q = b ≫ s)
    (ν : s'.ker.normalCone ⟶ s.ker.normalCone)
    (sqν : IsPullback ν (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g' s')
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s) b)
    (hzero : s'.normalConeZeroSection ≫ ν = b ≫ s.normalConeZeroSection)
    (κ : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family A g s ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj
        (sectionInvariant A g s))
    (κ' : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family A g' s' ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S' ↘ S')).obj
        (sectionInvariant A g' s'))
    (hκ : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized A g s hs κ)
    (hκ' : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized A g' s' hs' κ') :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A b).map
        (NoetherianSectionSpecialization.specialization A g s κ) ≫
      NoetherianSectionSpecialization.sectionMap A
        (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s) (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g' s') b ν sqν
        s.normalConeZeroSection s'.normalConeZeroSection hzero =
      NoetherianSectionSpecialization.sectionMap A g g' b q cart s s' hsec ≫
        NoetherianSectionSpecialization.specialization A g' s' κ'
